description: DansLab AI Chronicles trailer — Phase 2 hero stills. Generated via Higgsfield · Nano Banana 2. Each entry locks the prompt, the source job ID, and the Hyperframe motion pass that will turn the still into the cut clip.

assets.prompt: Cinematic aerial drone shot, slow forward push, over Cluj-Napoca old town at blue hour, low fog rolling between the orange-red tile rooftops, the Romanian Orthodox church spire centered, one single warm-yellow window glowing high in a 1970s apartment building on the right side of frame. Photographic, 35mm anamorphic feel, soft volumetric haze, no people visible, no text, no UI. Mood: lonely, deliberate, Mr. Robot grade. Light film grain. 16:9.

assets.notes: Phase-3 regen will swap GSD/Discovery/Monitor out for Memo + Nano + a fourth capital so the framing matches the new mythology (David + 4 capitals + Hermes).
assets.prompt: Cinematic wide shot, first-person POV from a Mac Studio desk in a Cluj-Napoca apartment loft. Six translucent holographic agents arranged in a circle on the desk... 'MISSION 01 · TARGET $100,000' ... Severance / Mr. Robot mood. 16:9.

assets.notes: The mythology reveal frame. Only frame in the trailer where the audience sees the doubling, never named.
assets.prompt: Cinematic split-frame portrait, hard centerline. Same character on both sides — Sienna ... LEFT HALF: bright green rim light + red-lobster bracelet. RIGHT HALF: amber rim light + brass paper-airplane sigil. 16:9.
Full-bleed cinematic frame, dead-center holographic typography '$100,000 / BY 2027', Telegram-blue glow, candlestick chart spiking, faint Hermes silhouette in lower-right. 16:9.
